title: Newsletter landing and archive
when: The user wants a page for a newsletter with a subscribe form and past issues.
prompt:
Goal: Show what subscribers get, with real past issues as proof, and a simple subscribe form.
Steps:
1. Headline with topic and frequency (every Friday, five minutes).
2. Subscribe form with labeled email field, submit button and privacy line.
3. Three highlights of what readers get.
4. Archive list: issue number, date, title, one line summary, link.
5. Short author note.
Quality bar:
- Frequency and length are promised plainly.
- Archive proves the value.
- Form errors are announced.
Pitfalls:
- Popups that block the content.
- No archive, so nobody knows the quality.
- Pre checked consent boxes.
Verify:
- [ ] Email field labeled and typed.
- [ ] Archive items have dates.
- [ ] Status region for messages.
- [ ] One h1.
Output: index.html, style.css and subscribe.js.

examples.input: página da minha newsletter sobre finanças pessoais
examples.output: headline weekly on Mondays, subscribe form, 10 past issues with dates
